chunks: And whatever is in it from ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad al-Ḥuṣaynī, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī Mājīlawayh—may Allah be pleased with him—from his uncle Muḥammad ibn Abī al-Qāsim, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī al-Kūfī, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad al-Ḥuṣaynī.

key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: May Allah be pleased with him; an honorific supplication for the narrator
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a formula indicating the author's own route of narration
key_terms.عَمِّهِ: His uncle; identifying the familial link within the transmission chain

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad al-Ḥuṣaynī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage records the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad al-Ḥuṣaynī. Its significance lies in documenting the line of transmission in hadith literature, clarifying how the material in the book reaches this narrator.
